newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa industrial stocks rally towards close.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa industrial stocks rally towards close.

text.p: 1408 GMT - South African industrial stocks rallied towards close in futures-related trade and on the back of some late overseas buying after drifting slightly weaker in dull market. Golds remain positive on firmer gold price. Market seen continuing firm on Tuesday with main focus on golds.
Brokers say turnover on the day reasonable with some big trades in De Beers.
Overall index adds 21.8 points to close at 7,042.5, industrials tick up 10.2 points to 8,315.5 and golds rise 23.6 points to 1,418.7.
De Beers jumps 200 cents to 148.50 rand and Anglos gain 100 cents to 278 rand.
